Not launched. NewDark Thief II is Direct3D, and D3D on vcr-kmd is supervised-only.
boxes.reason: It needs a supervised session with the user at the V5 6000 box.

boxes.evidence: Win7 32-bit with a GTX 1650 on the Standard VGA stub has no 3D driver. NewDark 1.26 needs a D3D9 HAL and has no software renderer.
boxes.reason: No D3D9 driver exists for this OS and GPU.

boxes.evidence: Not deployed. The gamegate override says 'not wanted on .243', and Thief2.exe has PE subsystem 5.0, which the Win98 loader refuses.
boxes.reason: The OS loader and the gate both rule it out.

summary: Thief II is single-player only, with no server. I re-checked it myself: all 7 applicable XP boxes (.110 .123 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) render the main menu fullscreen at their per-box modes. .124 is BLOCKED because D3D on vcr-kmd is supervised-only. .186 and .243 are NA. The game was closed everywhere and PROCLIST is clean.
issues: thief2.exe ignores WM_CLOSE: lanparty kill had to force-terminate it on all 7 boxes after the 12 s grace. No crash dialog followed, and every desktop came back at its normal mode (DISPLAYCFG checked).
Only the main menu was proven; no mission was loaded.
